title: Assurances make a report available
summary: Both cores have a report pending availability. 6 validators send assurances, each setting a bit for every core whose chunk it holds. A report becomes available when more than two thirds of the 6 validators set its bit; its core is then cleared.
params: the tiny chain the v0.8.0 vectors were made with ($\mathsf{E}$ = 12 slots per epoch, $\mathsf{Y}$ = 10, $\mathsf{C}$ = 2 cores, 6 validators), $\mathsf{U}$ = 5
notes: More than two thirds of 6 means at least 5. A report that is not yet available stays until it is, or until it times out at slot $t + \mathsf{U}$.
name: assurances-available

inputs.value: validator 0: core 1; validator 1: core 0; validator 2: core 0 and 1; validator 3: core 0 and 1; validator 4: core 0 and 1; validator 5: core 0
inputs.label: Assurances $\mathbf{E}_A$

check: The model's result equals the vector's expected output, compared as `lake build assurancestest` compares every vector of the suite; the generator repeats that comparison for this one. Signatures are checked by the suite's oracle, which accepts them all for this vector.
